articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the September meeting. To the editor: I have lived on Lilac Lane for 20 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program has made.

articles.title: Stella Vance, 66, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Stella Vance for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Stella Vance died in July at home on Bramble Lane, at the age of 66. Born in Bellwood in the years after the war, Stella Vance spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Cedar Hollow Garden Club in his or her name. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood.
